svg.title: ltpred pipeline: three uses from heritability, CIP, pedigree and family history
svg.desc: Before software: case definition. Population quantities: step 0 heritability and covariances, step 2 CIP or lifetime K. Use III, disease relationships and aetiology, can stop at 0 and/or 2. This sample: step 1 pedigree A, step 3 family history. Those become Sigma = h2 A and observation intervals D_F. Step 4 estimate_liability returns mu. Use I is risk prediction from family history with own status out, optional PGS. Use II is a GWAS of mu with own status in.
